notes:
Sorting by Max Hero on the Dashboard works. Clicking that column did nothing - the tick and warning marks in front of the number meant the sort could not read it as a number, so every row counted as zero.
Choose the columns on the Dashboard. The Active list has its own Columns button now, the same as the Data tabs, and Honor is available there for the first time. Sorting follows whatever you leave showing.
Empty a group without deleting it. Groups have an Empty button beside Edit - it takes every account out but keeps the group, its columns and its hero threshold, so you can refill it from + Members. The accounts themselves are never affected.
